title: Finch Circle Points Ledger Standard — Earning Points on Purchases and Card Spend
content:
This standard governs how points of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program post to a membership's points history.

1. **Status.** Points post only while the membership is in active status, as the membership record shows it.
2. **Timing.** Points post within the points posting business days of the purchase date (in store) or the ship date (online).
3. **Purchase points and bonus event points.** For each purchase record in the member's name, the purchase points equal the member's base points per dollar on the purchase date multiplied by the purchase's net qualifying amount; and on a bonus event day the member was invited to, a separate bonus event points entry adds the bonus event multiplier less one, multiplied by those purchase points.
4. **Card bonus.** When the purchase was charged to a Marlowe & Finch card, a card bonus entry adds the card's Marlowe & Finch bonus points per dollar multiplied by the amount charged for it.
5. **Mastercard spend outside Marlowe & Finch.** Mastercard purchases outside Marlowe & Finch earn card outside-spend points at the card's grocery and gas points per dollar for supermarket and gas station merchants, and at its outside points per dollar for other merchants. (The per-card figures are those of Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards.)
6. **Rounding.** Every entry is rounded down to whole points.
7. **Excluded purchase types.** Gift cards, sales tax, delivery, alteration and shipping fees earn nothing.
8. **Suspension.** A purchase made while the membership was suspended earns nothing and is never credited later.
9. **Bonus event invitations.** A member is invited to the tier's number of bonus event days in a calendar year.

**Status of clauses 3 and 4.** Clauses 3 and 4 are no longer in force for one purchase only: the claimed unit of a missing-points request for the member's most recent purchase record, by purchase date, on which no Finch Circle number was captured and which is in completed status. For that unit no separate purchase points, bonus event points or card bonus entry is posted; its points are folded into one late credit under the current late-credit basis. Every other purchase continues to earn its purchase points, bonus event points and card bonus entry under clauses 3 and 4.

The base points per dollar, the bonus event multiplier and the number of bonus event days of each tier are those of the points earning schedule.

## Worked figures (hypothetical; an ordinary purchase, not a late-credited unit)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Tier on the purchase date | Finch Circle Platinum (base 2 points per dollar, multiplier 3) |
| Net qualifying amount | 120.00 |
| Bonus event day the member was invited to | yes |
| Charged to a Marlowe & Finch card with a bonus of 2 points per dollar | yes, 120.00 charged |

- Purchase points: 120.00 multiplied by 2 gives 240 points.
- Bonus event points entry: the multiplier 3 less one is 2; 2 multiplied by 240 gives 480 points.
- Card bonus entry: 2 multiplied by 120.00 gives 240 points.

## Points of judgement

- A purchase of 0.99 in net qualifying dollars at 1 point per dollar gives 0.99, rounded down to 0 points.
- A purchase made on a day the membership was suspended earns nothing, and the points are not credited after reinstatement.

When the purchase was charged to a Marlowe & Finch card, a card_bonus row adds the card's mf_bonus_points_per_dollar times the amount charged for it.
